methods: Four Orcus/Vanth ALMA visits in Oct/Nov2016, separate from2015 Eris/Dysnomia visits and2018 Dysnomia followup. BB18 contains detailed flux reduction,not independently reproduced here.

Two point-source fits to interferometric visibilities with Gaussian initial positions; formal fitting,visibility-versus-image systematic and celestial frame terms combined in quadrature. Primary calibratorJ1048-1909; checkJ1022-1037/J0942-0759 averageoffset for Orcus/Vanth. These do not establish calibrated visible colour or local chemistry.

Oct13 conditions and Nov7 compact antenna configuration yield larger errors; observing-date labels lack independently audited rawUTC/product associations. No error correction or pixel registration transferred to app.

Six parameters: orbital phase correction,mass ratio,two constant system ephemeris offsets,two optical-versus-thermal primary photocentre offsets. Remaining orbital parameters inherited BB18,not independently constrained by these data.100000post-burn-in emcee samples;15.9/84.1percentile uncertainties. No chain/code reproduced.

alternativesAndLimits: Prose reports symmetric ratio.16±.02 and13.7±1.3percent system mass; Table2 reports asymmetric.16(-.01,+.02). Preserve both uncertainty presentations.
Prose optical/thermal primary offset2±3mas in both directions versus Table2x/y1±4mas; cause/convention remains open,not silently reconciled.
Prose says phase advanced4.3deg versus Table2 fitted phaseoffset.2±1.7deg. Reference/convention crosswalk remains open; no catalogue phase update.
Authors report10sigma barycentric-motion detection and reducedchi-square.95. This is not independent raw astrometric reproduction or confirmation of resolved terrain.

Derived densities use system mass6.32e20kg and adopted thermal diametersOrcus910(+50,-40),Vanth475±75km. Separate occultation443±10km assumes spherical shape; no ellipsoid/local normal or unified posterior inferred. Broad Vanth density may change with refinement; no local ice/rock fractions or chemistry assigned.

Near-pole-on primary inference follows low primary lightcurve/photocentre offset/orbital view,not a measured Vanth spin pole. Giant-impact intact-impactor and likely double-synchronous evolution are model interpretations,not directly observed origin/history or independently measured moon spin/permanent primary-facing site.

Small satellites of comparable fractional brightness to Pluto small moons would be below cited searches; apparent absence is not an exhaustive companion exclusion. Pluto/Charon comparisons do not authorize analog skins.

Do not transfer same-paper Dysnomia/Eris mass,diameter,thermal flux,emissivity or density constraints to Vanth/Orcus. No atmosphere/plume/liquid/ocean/biology/landing claim or angular/raster calculation.
